sections.kicker: Prepared for Luz Androetto by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: You do something few designers do. Your bio leads with what every designer does.
sections.keep: Your second line, "Combino fotografía y diseño para construir universos visuales." That is the reason to hire Luz.

title: Three things people

pins.quote: Branding e Identidad visual para tu próximo proyecto
pins.what: The bio opens with the line every branding designer uses.
pins.why: To charge more, the first line has to say why Luz, and this one could be anyone.
pins.how: Lead with the photo and design combination.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Clients compare you with every designer on price.

pins.quote: Combino fotografía y diseño para construir universos visuales
pins.what: Your real difference sits in the second line.
pins.why: Building a visual world with your own photos is rare and worth more.
pins.how: Make it the headline and name the offer around it.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The reason to pay more is read second, if at all.

pins.what: The name line lists two trades.
pins.why: Graphic design and photography read as two jobs, not one point of view.
pins.how: Name the one thing you do that joins them.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: Clients book you for one of the two, at the price of one.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Luz Androetto's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Kinfolk, from another category. Photography and design read as one voice.
